'''2007 Endor Regionals Zack Carter LS Hoth''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Zack Carter]] at [[2007 Endor Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Zack's EBO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
